name: pixel-buddy
title: Pixel Buddy
tagline: A pixel pet in the footer that eats what your work drops, levels up and finds rare trophies.
tagline_ru: Пиксельный питомец в подвале: ест то, что остается от работы, растет в уровнях и находит редкие трофеи.
description: A pixel pet that sits in the footer next to the status line, or above the prompt when the terminal is narrower than 130 columns. Claude answers, it gets a cookie. Tests pass, a fish. A commit or a finished plan, a cake. It walks over, eats it, and snacks turn into levels. 8 species, rarity and stats rolled once, 1 egg in 100 hatches shiny, and a nest keeps up to 12 buddies. 14 trophies with fireworks, 6 of them secret, and a trophy case of pixel badges (`/buddy trophies`). Click to pet it, double click for its own move, click an empty spot to throw a ball, right click for the menu. `share` copies a card of your buddy drawn in emoji squares. No network, no model calls, no tokens: every hook passes its event on unchanged.

transcript.text: Fix the retry of a failed payment and commit it.

transcript.input: git commit -m "fix: retry of a failed payment"

preview.caption: A commit drops a cake, the ninja eats it, and a commit at 3 am earns Night Owl.
preview.caption_ru: Коммит роняет торт, ниндзя его съедает, а коммит в 3 ночи дает трофей Night Owl.

elements.text: 🦉 Trophy: Night Owl, rare, for a commit between 2 and 5 at night. 1 of 14 found. Menu → share to show it off
